text.en:
The provisions of existing laws to the contrary notwithstanding, the Presiding Justice and
Associate Justices of the Court of Appeals and the Presiding Judge and Judges of other inferior courts shall
receive the following salaries:
(a) The Presiding Justice of the Court of Appeals shall receive a salary of P54,000.00 per annum; and each
Associate Justice shall receive a salary of P50,000.00 per annum.
(b) The Judges of the Courts of First Instance, Circuit Criminal Courts, Juvenile and Domestic Relations
Courts shall receive a salary of P40,000.00 per annum.
(c) The Presiding Judges of the Court of Tax Appeals, the Court of Agrarian Relations and the Court of
Industrial Relations shall each receive P42,000.00 per annum; and each of the Associate Judges of said courts
shall receive P40,000.00 per annum.

The salary differentials resulting from the adjustment of salaries as provided in this Decree shall
be paid out of the specific appropriation in Presidential Decree No. 233, which is hereby programmed for
expenditure effective as January 1, 1974.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
